tools.name: search_businesses
tools.title: Search One World Morocco businesses
tools.description: Search the public One World Morocco catalog of curated businesses (restaurants, hotels, riads, activities, boutiques) in Marrakech, Essaouira and across Morocco. Returns name, city, category, rating, price range, hook description and public URL.

query.description: Free-text search: a name, cuisine, activity, neighborhood, e.g. 'rooftop marrakech', 'riad essaouira', 'couscous'.

tools.name: get_business
tools.title: Get One World Morocco business details
tools.description: Fetch the full public details of a single One World Morocco business by its slug (from the URL, e.g. 'dar-fragrance'). Returns description, address, phone, website, hours, ratings, prices and social links.

slug.description: Business slug from the oneworldmorocco.com URL, e.g. 'dar-fragrance'.

tools.name: get_business_relations
tools.title: Get related POIs, destinations and events for a business
tools.description: For a One World Morocco business (by slug), return the linked points of interest (nearby attractions), destinations (tourist zones), and events. Use to answer 'what's around', 'what's happening at', 'which zone' questions.

slug.description: Business slug from the oneworldmorocco.com URL, e.g. 'dar-fragrance'.

tools.name: list_businesses_near_poi
tools.title: List One World Morocco businesses linked to a POI
tools.description: For a given point of interest name (e.g. 'Jemaa el-Fna', 'Jardin Majorelle', 'Skala de la Kasbah'), return the curated businesses explicitly linked to that POI (walking distance / cluster). Use for 'near / around / next to <landmark>' questions.

tools.name: list_blog_articles
tools.title: List One World Morocco blog articles
tools.description: List the published One World Morocco editorial articles (slug, title, excerpt, URL). Optionally filter by free-text on the title. Use it to find the slug to pass to `get_blog_article`.

query.description: Optional free-text filter on the title or slug.

tools.name: get_blog_article
tools.title: Read a One World Morocco blog article
tools.description: Read the full public content of a One World Morocco editorial article (blog) by slug, or by free-text title search. Returns title, TL;DR, intro, every ranked entry (pretitle, title, paragraphs, opening hours), FAQ and the public URL. Example slug: 'idee-cadeau-marrakech' for the article 'Trouver une bonne idée cadeau à Marrakech'.

slug.description: Article slug from the URL, e.g. 'idee-cadeau-marrakech'.

query.description: Free-text search on the article title if the slug is unknown, e.g. 'idée cadeau'.

lang.description: Language of the content to return (default 'fr').
